title: rosa × dumetorum f. obtusifolia
intro: Rosa × dumetorum f. obtusifolia, commonly known as wild rose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa × dumetorum f. obtusifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve sleep, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
